relationships.evidence_quote: These mAbs bind to CGRP or its receptor, blocking their action and preventing the onset of migraine attacks [10].

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab

key_findings: Systematic review of 8 studies: all four anti-CGRP mAbs are safe and effective for migraine prevention
Combination with onabotulinumtoxinA may give incremental benefit
